correctness.rationale: Orthogonality applied to U cubed gives one double fiber, (0,3,3) and (1,1,4), of multiplicity three for each monomial. The resulting cross term has coefficient 18 and its phase upper bound is attainable. Equalizing either reflected mass pair at fixed sum s strictly increases the diagonal cubic by (18-12s) times the squared imbalance and does not lower the phase-optimized cross term. On the two coordinate edges the maximum is 31/9; on the central-zero edge it is (97 sqrt(97)-260)/162 < 9/2, while equal masses give 563/125 > 9/2. An interior maximizer therefore exists, and elimination and the single positive quartic root prove uniqueness. Positivity then gives exactly the stated phase condition, with no other restriction. Independent enumeration of all 125 ordered triples, symbolic boundary/elimination checks, and high-precision evaluation recovered 4.5186200812816083658776462004075355 and its sixth root 1.28578287735726312716. The uniform optimization is analytic, not inferred from numerical tests.
residual_risks: The result is for five consecutive modes and the full normalized spacetime torus, not other bandwidths or observation measures.
